name: Plongeur Aquatique
description: Gardien des nurseries protégeant les jeunes générations de l'Exode contre les prédateurs et les menaces extérieures.

subject.archetype: Plongeur Aquatique — Exode pélagique Uncommon class furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Organic coral armor grown from living reef material with bioluminescent combat indicators pulsing in rapid rhythm, hydrodynamic fins extending from arms and calves streaming in current, translucent membranes trailing from shoulders
loadout.arsenal: Bioluminescent harpoon cannon with living coral barrel pulsing with each discharge, hydro-kinetic gauntlets channeling water into pressurized cutting jets visible as focused force streams Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

scenography.setting: Storm-ravaged aquatic colonial battlefield with massive waves crashing over organic structures sending debris flying, lightning illuminating in stark flashes, allied forces pushed back while bioluminescent defensive flares light the water column with cyan bursts
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Massive waves crashing and spraying bioluminescent droplets everywhere, water vortex spiraling around character pulling debris, glowing fish scattering in panic, bubbles erupting from seabed, electrical arcs flashing through charged seawater
